mapper.sql: t.task_id AS taskId,t.task_no AS taskNo,t.task_name AS taskName,t.dept_id AS deptId, t.scope_dept_id AS scopeDeptId,t.scope_location_id AS scopeLocationId,t.scope_category_id AS scopeCategoryId, t.start_time AS startTime,t.end_time AS endTime,t.status,t.publisher_user_id AS publisherUserId, t.publish_time AS publishTime,t.submit_time AS submitTime,t.complete_user_id AS completeUserId, t.complete_time AS completeTime,t.create_by AS createBy,t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime,t.remark
mapper.select: SELECT , d.dept_name AS deptName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ca_inventory_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.task_id) AS totalCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ca_inventory_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.task_id AND i.checked_time IS NOT NULL) AS checkedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ca_inventory_item i WHERE i.task_id=t.task_id AND i.review_status='1') AS reviewedCount FROM ca_inventory_task t LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=t.dept_id WHERE t.task_id=#{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id=rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' AND m.status='0' AND m.perms IN ('campus:inventory:execute','*:*:*') )

SELECT CASE WHEN (#{deptId} IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id=#{deptId} AND status='0' AND del_flag='0')) AND (#{locationId} IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ca_location WHERE location_id=#{locationId} AND status='0')) AND (#{categoryId} IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ca_category WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} AND status='0')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

WITH RECURSIVE locations AS ( SELECT location_id FROM ca_location WHERE location_id=#{task.scopeLocationId} UNION DISTINCT SELECT c.location_id FROM ca_location c JOIN locations p ON c.parent_id=p.location_id ), categories AS ( SELECT category_id FROM ca_category WHERE category_id=#{task.scopeCategoryId} UNION DISTINCT SELECT c.category_id FROM ca_category c JOIN categories p ON c.parent_id=p.category_id ) SELECT a.asset_id AS assetId,a.asset_code AS assetCode,a.asset_name AS assetName, a.dept_id AS deptId,a.location_id AS locationId,a.category_id AS categoryId,a.keeper_user_id AS keeperUserId FROM ca_asset a JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=a.dept_id WHERE a.asset_status != '3'
AND (d.dept_id=#{task.scopeDeptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{task.scopeDeptId},d.ancestors))
AND a.location_id IN (SELECT location_id FROM locations) AND a.category_id IN (SELECT category_id FROM categories) AND (#{q.unrestricted}=TRUE
OR a.dept_id IN #{dept}
OR a.keeper_user_id=#{q.selfUserId}) ORDER BY a.asset_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ca_inventory_task SET status=#{status},update_by=#{operator},update_time=NOW(3), submit_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='2' THEN NOW(3) ELSE submit_time END, complete_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='3' THEN NOW(3) ELSE complete_time END, complete_user_id=CASE WHEN #{status}='3' THEN #{userId} ELSE complete_user_id END WHERE task_id=#{id} AND status=#{expected} AND publish_time IS NOT NULL
mapper.sql: i.item_id AS itemId,i.task_id AS taskId,i.asset_id AS assetId,i.assigned_user_id AS assignedUserId, i.base_snapshot AS baseSnapshot,i.scan_time AS scanTime,i.checked_user_id AS checkedUserId, i.checked_time AS checkedTime,i.observed_location_id AS observedLocationId, i.observed_condition AS observedCondition,i.missing_flag AS missingFlag,i.check_note AS checkNote, i.review_status AS reviewStatus,i.review_user_id AS reviewUserId,i.review_time AS reviewTime, i.review_note AS reviewNote,i.review_snapshot AS reviewSnapshot,i.resolved_location_id AS resolvedLocationId, i.resolved_condition AS resolvedCondition,i.repair_id AS repairId,i.scrap_id AS scrapId
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ca_asset_history h JOIN ca_inventory_task t ON t.task_id=#{taskId} WHERE h.asset_id=#{assetId} AND h.event_time >= t.publish_time
mapper.update: UPDATE ca_asset SET location_id=COALESCE(#{locationId},location_id), condition_status=COALESCE(#{condition},condition_status), borrow_enabled=CASE WHEN #{condition} IN ('1','2') THEN '0' ELSE borrow_enabled END, update_by=#{operator},update_time=NOW(3) WHERE asset_id=#{assetId} AND asset_status != '3'
